audit_log.notes: Added verification_summary.evidence_paths.{source,target} two-sided convention. verification_status retained as MANUAL_CURATION_AGAINST_5_8_SOURCE (classifies as TARGET_ONLY_SOURCE_INFERRED in validator). HEADER_001-003 already removed via #11601; current header_relocations[] is empty so no source-side claims to attest. evidence_path singular key retained for transition compatibility.

Added CONFIG_021 (MinDesiredFrameRate removed) and CONFIG_022 ([HTTP.Curl] bForbidReuse removed) as two-sided-verified config_changes for 5.7->5.8. Evidence trees: source=C:/Program Files/Epic Games/UE_5.7, target=C:/Program Files/Epic Games/UE_5.8 (both Launcher installs with full Engine/Source + Engine/Config on Build03PC). Method per docs/development/MIGRATION_DATA_VERIFICATION.md: ConfigRedirects.ini diff (5.7 vs 5.8) + Engine/Source rg present-5.7/absent-5.8. verification_status unchanged: config_changes carries no source-side path claims (old_path/old_signature), so the #11578 two-sided ERROR check does not apply to it. The /Script/Party.SocialSettings_XboxCommonGDK -> SocialSettingsXbl SECTION rename (5.8 ConfigRedirects.ini:27, absent in 5.7) is documented as a finding, NOT added as a row: scan_deprecated matches on section+key and a whole-section rename has no fixed key; the engine ConfigRedirect auto-applies it at load. Rejected non-deprecations (documented for audit): BaseScalability.ini CVar removals (r.HeterogeneousVolumes etc. still registered in 5.8 source), BaseEngine.ini DDC config sections (still read by 5.8 source), and the 5.7-era HTTP redirects dropped in 5.8 (deprecation predates 5.7; undatable without <=5.6 engines).

evidence_paths.source: C:/Program Files/Epic Games/UE_5.7 (Launcher install) or equivalent 5.7 source build

verification_summary.note: All entries verified against 5.8 source tree at D:/UE/ue5-58 (Build.version = 5.8.0). Issue #11574: HEADER_001/002/003 entries removed — `old_path` headers (LiveCoding.h / LiveCodingModule.h / LiveCodingSubsystem.h) never existed in 5.7's `Engine/Source/Developer/Windows/LiveCoding/Public/` (only `ILiveCodingModule.h` exists in both 5.7 and 5.8); the 5.8 `LiveCodingToolset` plugin headers are NEW UCLASS wrappers, not relocations of pre-existing 5.7 content. Issue #11578: evidence_paths.{source,target} added per two-sided verification convention.

breaking_changes.impact: Projects that referenced ECABridge in .uproject Plugins[] or had editor automation flows wired through ECA must migrate to MCPClientToolset.
migration_steps: Enable MCPClientToolset via Editor Preferences > Plugins > MCP Toolset Servers
Add 'MCPClientToolset' to .uproject Plugins[] if the project needs it loaded at startup
Update any custom code calling ECA APIs to use the MCP Toolset surface (see Engine/Plugins/Experimental/Toolsets/MCPClientToolset/Source/Public/)

breaking_changes.impact: Plugins or projects that depend on the umbrella 'AllRestrictedToolsets' module via .Build.cs PluginDependencies or .uplugin Plugins[] will fail to resolve.
migration_steps: Replace 'AllRestrictedToolsets' references with 'AllToolsets' in .uplugin Plugins[] entries
Verify all individual *Toolset plugins moved under Engine/Plugins/Experimental/Toolsets/ (e.g., GASToolsets, NiagaraToolsets, StateTreeToolset)

config_changes.notes: UEngine::MinDesiredFrameRate was removed in UE 5.8. Two-sided evidence: present in 5.7 (Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Classes/Engine/Engine.h:1813 UPROPERTY(config) float MinDesiredFrameRate; consumed in GameViewportClient.cpp:1252-1253 for the bDropDetail/bAggressiveLOD heuristics; Config/BaseEngine.ini:324 'MinDesiredFrameRate=35.000000'), absent from 5.8 Engine source (0 references) and 5.8 BaseEngine.ini. No direct replacement — remove the key.

[HTTP.Curl] bForbidReuse was removed in UE 5.8. Two-sided evidence: Epic's own remap declared in 5.8 Engine/Config/ConfigRedirects.ini:58-60 ('bForbidReuse has been removed, config it through http.CurlReuseConnectionEnable or change it through CVarHttpCurlReuseConnectionEnabled instead'); the redirect is absent from 5.7 ConfigRedirects.ini. Replacement key 'http.CurlReuseConnectionEnable' has inverted semantics (bForbidReuse=true corresponds to CurlReuseConnectionEnable=false), so it is not a mechanical rename.

notes: Issue #11395 body cited 'DefaultToolsets.uplugin' as a new file — verification against D:/UE/ue5-58 found 'AllToolsets.uplugin' at Engine/Plugins/Experimental/Toolsets/AllToolsets/ instead. Entry BREAK_002 covers this.

Issue #11395 body cited StateTree commit hashes (d25d1f85, cbea7a6b, 2bf91da0, 2cc48484, a4863512) as deprecated_apis evidence — these are not verifiable against a non-git engine mirror. Deferred to a follow-up issue when radbin/git access to engine mirror is available.

Issue #11395 body cited '[/Script/MCPClientToolset.MCPToolsetSettings]' as a new INI section — not found in Engine/Config/ default hierarchy in 5.8 source. Likely plugin-side runtime registration; deferred until observable.

BreakingChangeCategory enum is restricted to method-level variants (signature_change, parameter_added, parameter_removed, type_change, pure_virtual_added, method_made_final, member_removed). Plugin-level changes are encoded as 'member_removed' with descriptive 'change_type' free-text field.

Issue #11574: HEADER_001/002/003 entries removed. Original entries claimed LiveCoding.h / LiveCodingModule.h / LiveCodingSubsystem.h were relocated from Engine/Source/Developer/Windows/LiveCoding/Public/ to the new LiveCodingToolset plugin in 5.8.

Issue #11574 evidence: cross-verification against C:/UnrealEngine/5.7/UE_5.7 (5.7.4) and C:/UnrealEngines/UE_5.8_source (5.8.0) confirmed (a) the three old_path headers never existed in 5.7 — Public/ contained only ILiveCodingModule.h; (b) the 5.8 LiveCodingToolset plugin headers (LiveCodingToolset.h / LiveCodingToolsetModule.h / LiveCodingToolsetSubsystem.h) are NEW UCLASS wrappers exposing AICallable MCP tools, not relocated content.
Issue #11574 conclusion: ILiveCodingModule.h remains the canonical 5.7 → 5.8 path, unchanged. The new LiveCodingToolset plugin is a new optional surface, not a migration.

Issue #18229: two config_changes added for 5.7→5.8 (CONFIG_021 [/Script/Engine.Engine] MinDesiredFrameRate removed; CONFIG_022 [HTTP.Curl] bForbidReuse removed), two-sided-verified against UE_5.7 + UE_5.8 (see _metadata.audit_log 2026-07-02). The /Script/Party.SocialSettings_XboxCommonGDK → SocialSettingsXbl section rename is engine-auto-redirected (5.8 ConfigRedirects.ini) and documented, not added as a key-oriented row. BaseScalability/DDC/pre-5.7-HTTP candidates were rejected — no two-sided evidence.
